seo.title: Essential Tools for Web3 Community Managers
seo.description: A curated list of tools for Web3 community managers covering Discord management, engagement, analytics, and member coordination.

content.intro: Community management in Web3 requires specialized tools for token-gated access, engagement tracking, and managing 24/7 global communities. Here are the essentials.

items.name: Collab.Land
items.description: Token gating for Discord and Telegram. Verify holders. Used by production teams across the ecosystem.

items.name: Guild.xyz
items.description: Advanced role and access management based on on-chain activity.

items.name: Carl-bot
items.description: Moderation, logging, and reaction roles. Used by production teams across the ecosystem.

items.name: MEE6
items.description: Leveling, moderation, and custom commands. Used by production teams across the ecosystem.

items.name: Dyno
items.description: Moderation, auto-moderation, and announcements. Used by production teams across the ecosystem.

items.name: Wick
items.description: Security bot for raid protection and anti-spam. Used by production teams across the ecosystem.

items.name: Zealy (Crew3)
items.description: Quest and task platform for community engagement. Used by production teams across the ecosystem.

items.name: Galxe
items.description: Credential and campaign platform with NFT rewards. Used by production teams across the ecosystem.

items.name: Layer3
items.description: Learn-to-earn quests with on-chain verification. Used by production teams across the ecosystem.

items.name: Snapshot
items.description: Governance voting for community decisions. Free and open-source.

items.name: Tally
items.description: On-chain governance for DAOs. Use for web3 community manager workflows.

items.name: Statbot
items.description: Discord analytics and statistics. Worth evaluating for your workflow.

items.name: Commonroom
items.description: Community intelligence across platforms. Provides dashboards and alerting for production use.

items.name: Discord Server Insights
items.description: Built-in Discord analytics for large servers. Provides dashboards and alerting for production use.

items.name: Notion
items.description: Documentation and wikis for community resources. Used by production teams across the ecosystem.

items.name: Luma
items.description: Event management for community events. Worth evaluating for your workflow.

items.name: Paragraph
items.description: Web3-native newsletter platform. Worth evaluating for your workflow.

items.name: Riverside
items.description: Recording platform for community calls and podcasts. Used by production teams across the ecosystem.

items.name: StreamYard
items.description: Live streaming to multiple platforms. Worth evaluating for your workflow.

items.name: Coordinape
items.description: Peer-to-peer reward allocation for contributors. Free and open-source.

items.name: POAP
items.description: Attendance NFTs for events and milestones. Free and open-source.

items.name: Soulbound Tokens
items.description: Non-transferable tokens for achievements. Used by production teams across the ecosystem.

items.name: Superfluid
items.description: Token streaming for continuous contributor payments. Used by production teams across the ecosystem.

items.name: Intercom
items.description: Customer support with chat and help center. Used by production teams across the ecosystem.

items.name: Zendesk
items.description: Enterprise support ticketing system. Worth evaluating for your workflow.

items.name: Discord Ticket Bot
items.description: Create support tickets within Discord. Worth evaluating for your workflow.

items.name: GitBook
items.description: Documentation platform for help articles. Used by production teams across the ecosystem.

items.name: FAQ Bot
items.description: Auto-answer common questions in Discord. Used by production teams across the ecosystem.

items.name: HelpDocs
items.description: Simple knowledge base for community docs. Used by production teams across the ecosystem.

items.name: SocialBlade
items.description: Track social media growth over time. Worth evaluating for your workflow.

items.name: Kaito
items.description: AI-powered crypto social media analytics. Provides dashboards and alerting for production use.

proTips.tip: Guild.xyz is more flexible than Collab.Land for complex role requirements.
Rotate moderators across time zones for 24/7 coverage.
Use quests strategically. Too many creates fatigue.
Build a contributor program with clear levels and rewards.
Document everything. Community knowledge should not be in one person's head.
